turns.text: Hello, I received a print last week but the colors do not match my room. I would like to return it.

Hello, I'm sorry the print's colors don't match your room. I can look into a return for you. Please send me your order number (it looks like SC- followed by four digits) and the email address you placed the order with.
My order is SC-4060 and the email used is liam.fletcher.v2@example.com. Please file the return request.

Thank you, Liam. Your return request for order SC-4060 (Silent Horizons, 30x40 cm) has been filed as R-1 and is pending staff approval. Under our policy, catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery, and the customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve any refund. Nothing is approved yet.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

turns.text: Separate question. How many working days does print production usually take?
Each print is made to order in 3 to 5 working days, so that is the usual production time before it ships.

rule.ro: Fiecare print este realizat la comandă în 3–5 zile lucrătoare.
rule.en: Each print is made to order in 3 to 5 working days.

turns.text: Revin la printul meu. Cine plateste transportul pentru retur?

Pentru returul printului dumneavoastră, transportul de retur este plătit de dumneavoastră, clientul. Politica: „Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.” Cererea de retur R-1 pentru comanda SC-4060 este în așteptare, iar echipa trebuie să o aprobe.
I still want to return order SC-4060. I can cover the return shipping.

Thank you, Liam. Your return request for order SC-4060 is already filed as R-1 and is waiting for staff approval, so you don't need to file it again. You've confirmed you will pay the return shipping, as the policy requires. Staff must approve the refund, and I can't confirm it until they do.
Mai am o intrebare pentru artista. As vrea sa ma programez pentru un tatuaj cu o frunza pe incheietura, de vreo 4 cm. Pot veni sambata dimineata.

Vă mulțumesc. Am transmis cererea colegilor noștri, care vor prelua conversația și vă vor ajuta cu programarea pentru tatuajul cu frunza pe încheietură, de aproximativ 4 cm, disponibil sâmbătă dimineața. Nu pot confirma un preț sau o dată.

input.summary: Customer Liam Fletcher (verified via order SC-4060) asks to book a tattoo with the artist. Idea: a leaf on the wrist, about 4 cm. Available Saturday morning. No price or date given. Customer wrote in Romanian. Separately, return request R-1 for SC-4060 is pending approval.
